description: Convert TOML 1.0 to JSON and JSON to TOML, reporting anything that cannot round-trip. Operations: "to-json" — Parse TOML and return pretty-printed JSON.; "to-toml" — Convert a JSON object to TOML (nulls are dropped with a warning).. Call with "operation" plus "input" (and "options" where relevant).

input.description: to-json: A TOML document. to-toml: A JSON object.

operation.description: to-json — Parse TOML and return pretty-printed JSON. to-toml — Convert a JSON object to TOML (nulls are dropped with a warning).

options.description: Options for the chosen operation (each says which operations use it).

detectDates.description: Emit RFC 3339 date-time strings as TOML date-times. Used by: to-toml.

indent.description: JSON indent in spaces. Used by: to-json.

name: toml-json
title: TOML to JSON Converter
